EN:
"Live well, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}live long, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}and leave a

aliens to study."
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}That's what I always say.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0025:}}Well, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}and
{{TAG:0005:0007:}}, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}of course.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}¿Crees que si nos convertimos en
fósiles, la gente del futuro nos
expondrá en un museo también?
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}¡Es una pena que nunca lleguemos
a saberlo!
FR:
J'aime beaucoup venir dans cette
galerie.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Quand je vois tous ces vieux
os, je me sens, comment dire...{{TAG:0007:0000:20000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Plus jeune. {{TAG:0007:0000:20000000}}Oui, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}c'est cela,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} plus

"Stai serena, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}pensa alla salute
{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}e lascia tracce fossili della tua

poi ci sarebbe anche "{{TAG:0005:0007:}}".

Fossilien abgeben.

Jahren der Wissenschaft dienen.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}

ES:
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Cuando me siento muy mayor,
vengo a ver estos fósiles.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0002:}}¡Mi edad no es nada comparada
con la suya, ja, ja!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Comparée à tous ces fossiles, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}j'ai
l'air d'une petite jeunette, hi hi !
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}80 Jahre ist kein Alter{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} für ein

EN:
{{TAG:0003:002B:}}Can you imagine what all of these
creatures must have looked like
when they walked the planet?
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}},{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} I wish I could have
seen them! {{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}I guess my favorite
dinosaur movie will have to suffice.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}¿Te imaginas cómo deberían de ser
estas criaturas cuando estaban
vivas?
Aunque me habría gustado verlo,
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}tendré que conformarme con
las películas.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}Je me demande de quelle couleur ils
étaient de leur vivant...{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:002B:}}J'aurais bien aimé en voir un vrai de
près... {{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}Enfin, {{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}de pas trop près non
plus...
IT:
{{TAG:0003:002B:}}Non riesco a immaginare quale
aspetto potessero avere questi
bestioni quando erano vivi...
{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}},{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} vorrei tornare
indietro nel tempo solo per vederli!{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}Mmmh, forse vedo troppi film...
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Kannst du dir vorstellen, wie diese
Kreaturen ausgesehen haben mögen?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ich würde gerne einmal die Welt von
damals bereisen, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}
Du etwa nicht?
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:002B:}}Bütün bu canlıların dünyada yürürken
nasıl göründüğünü hayal edebiliyor musun?
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}},{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} keşke görebilseydim! {{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Şimdilik
en sevdiğim dinozor filmiyle idare edeceğim.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Wow, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}I haven't seen this many
ancient fossils since the last time I
opened Grandma's freezer!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}¿No te da la sensación de que se
van a mover en cualquier momento?
FR:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Oh !{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} C'est vraiment étrange !{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}} Cette
odeur...{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}} Cela me rappelle la maison
de mes grands-parents...
IT:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Perbacco! {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}Non vedevo tanti fossili
dall'ultima volta che ho aperto
il frigo della mia adorata nonna!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}So viele Fossilien habe ich nicht
mehr gesehen, seit ich{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0026:}} das letzte
Mal hier war.

{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Vay, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}bu kadar çok antik fosili en son
büyükannemin dondurucusunu açtığımda görmüştüm!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}I wonder what future scientists and
archaeologists will think of the
fossils we leave behind.
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}You're right—{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}they'll probably be too
busy battling sentient robots to
think about such things.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Me pregunto qué pensarán los
científicos del futuro de los fósiles
que nosotros dejaremos atrás.
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Aunque probablemente estarán
ocupados luchando contra robots
asesinos o algo parecido.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Je me demande ce que les
archéologues du futur penseront de
nous...
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Ils diront peut-être que nous
n'étions que des êtres primitifs sans
aucun goût en matière de mode.
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Chissà cosa penseranno gli scienziati
e gli archeologi dei fossili che
rimarranno del nostro tempo...?
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Hai ragione,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} probabilmente se ne
staranno in panciolle tutto il giorno
e lasceranno il lavoro ai robot!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Welche Schlüsse die Wissenschaft
wohl in ferner Zukunft aus unseren
fossilen Überresten ziehen wird?
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Oder meinst du, die Forscher
müssen sich dann eher dem Kampf
gegen abtrünnige Roboter widmen?
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Acaba geleceğin bilim insanları ve
arkeologları bizim bıraktığımız fosiller
hakkında ne düşünecek?
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Haklısın—{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}muhtemelen düşünen robotlarla
savaşmaktan bunları düşünecek vakitleri olmayacak.
